title: How AI Actually Calls an API? Tool Calling Explained from Scratch
why_read: A clear, beginner-friendly explanation of how LLM tool calling actually works under the hood is useful for engineers new to building AI agent systems.
analysis: This post explains the mechanics of 'tool calling' in LLM applications, clarifying the common misconception that the model itself executes code, when in reality it just outputs a structured request that the surrounding application code interprets and executes. It walks through basic examples of giving a model access to one or two external tools, like fetching live data, to demonstrate the request-response loop. This is solid, practical, correct information for developers building LLM-powered applications, though it covers ground that's already well-documented elsewhere.
